client: custom C++17 epoll RESP2 client; identical executable for all systems; microsecond-rounded per-request samples; pair timings measured separately
dataset_bytes_note: payload only; excludes names, scores, IDs, metadata and indexes
comparison: All four systems newly measured, one round per new workload
user_steering: Only test PR, no baseline rerun. 8192 keys,80 connections,one formal round
set_pair: Each connection owns one member slot per key, toggling a/b; SADD alternate then SREM current. 80 active slots of32768.
response_validation: Every full-read response checked for exact cardinality, unique fields/members, payload bytes or members/scores/order; array framing incremental. Client validation included in reported latency; same client for all.
